verificationNotes: The broad batch passed 35 of 36 cases; its 320px card-density failure was fixed by keeping reference-specific transfer controls in the References footer. All six compact-layout cases passed in the next batch.

After the compact batch, reserved-study generic updates were hardened against source/count changes, and reference save completion was guarded against newer selections. All six final authoring scenarios and 51 targeted units passed after these changes.
38 is the number of distinct scenarios across the batches, counting each title once using its latest result. No flaky or skipped cases occurred.
Capacity fixtures adopt existing generated approximations. Full source-ID export reconciliation covers 1283 IDs and 2567 participants, not newly authored geometry.

Previous 203-scene rendering evidence remains historical; generated data, solver, worker, renderer and model assets are unchanged. No complete historical unit suite or full rendering sweep was repeated.
limits: Authored is an unreviewed workflow label, not source fidelity, distinct geometry or physical certification.
The 0.25m world-X separation check uses posed coarse body bounds without intimate anatomy, not precise mesh intersection, balance, support or clothing simulation.
Studies remain browser-local; backups require JSON export. Browser/device/assistive-technology certification is not claimed.
No cloud service, source imagery, new dependency or hosted deployment.
